title: MySQL/MariaDB
description: Connections, queries, slow queries, traffic, InnoDB buffer pool and replication, with a user that has PROCESS and REPLICATION CLIENT.

address.title: Address
address.description: host:port of the server (loopback unless module_targets of agent.toml allows more).

user.title: User
user.description: A user with PROCESS and REPLICATION CLIENT (MariaDB: REPLICA MONITOR) and nothing more.

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: off, verify (the certificate against the system's CAs), no_verify (any certificate; MySQL's own certificates). MySQL 8 needs TLS or the socket for the first login of caching_sha2_password.
